purpose: Install the reviewed atomic finished-ad debit/receipt RPC before deploying its quota.ts callers. This preparation performs no target writes, quota debits or provider calls.

target.observationSource: Root agent's read-only target catalog inspection; not independently queried by proposal builder.
target.selectionGuard: The approved apply_migration call must use this exact project_id. SQL cannot attest the Supabase project ref by itself. Recheck identity and absence immediately before applying.

applyArguments.name: companion_finished_ad_meter_atomic
applyArguments.query: Read the exact sqlFile bytes after confirming rawSha256; do not substitute this sentence as SQL.

proposal.approval: A later explicit human approval is required for this exact target, SQL hash and operation. Preparation is not approval.

source.bodyNormalization: Replace CRLF with LF in pg_proc.prosrc only; preserve all other whitespace, comments and leading/trailing newlines. Do not collapse whitespace or trim.
changes: CREATE OR REPLACE becomes bare CREATE so an existing exact-signature function cannot be silently overwritten.
The function parameters, return type, body, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path, REVOKE and GRANT remain identical to the reviewed source.
An atomic deployment wrapper adds prerequisite checks, catalog postconditions, local timeout settings and a commit-delivered PostgREST schema-cache notification.

successCriteria: Exact target identity confirmed and exact-signature function absent immediately before applying.
One function is created as postgres with exact normalized body MD5, jsonb return, plpgsql language, SECURITY DEFINER and exactly search_path=public.

The only explicit non-owner ACL is non-grantable service_role EXECUTE. PUBLIC and every unexpected non-owner ACL are rejected. Effective EXECUTE is denied to anon and authenticated and allowed to service_role.
The migration runner reports success, migration history is confirmed, and a fresh read-only catalog query confirms the same definition and ACLs.
No subscriptions, rate_limits, receipts, balances, provider jobs or user data are inserted, updated, deleted or purged by the deployment wrapper.
Deploy updated quota.ts callers only after the migration and separate transport/schema-cache verification succeed.
failureCriteria: Wrong or unconfirmed target, changed SQL/source hash, existing RPC, missing prerequisite tables/functions/roles, or migration role other than postgres.
Lock timeout, SQL error, definition mismatch, PUBLIC/unexpected ACL or failed effective-role permission check.
Uncertain migration outcome, missing migration history or inability to confirm catalog state. Do not blindly retry or deploy callers.
PostgREST schema reload notification alone is not proof the RPC is reachable through the Data API.

transactionAndLimits.atomicUnit: A single DO statement contains bare CREATE, ACL changes and postconditions. Any exception rolls back that statement's changes. No nested BEGIN/COMMIT can prematurely commit an apply_migration outer transaction.
transactionAndLimits.connectorSemantics: The exposed apply_migration tool documents DDL/migration recording but does not specify its outer transaction or request-timeout implementation. The wrapper does not depend on it for DDL/ACL atomicity.
transactionAndLimits.lockTimeout: 2 seconds per lock acquisition, set locally inside the atomic DO before catalog DDL.
transactionAndLimits.statementTimeout: 15s setting is local, but setting it inside an already-running DO does not establish a verified hard 15-second wall-clock cap for that top-level DO. Do not claim such a cap.
transactionAndLimits.requestTimeout: The applying operator must use a bounded migration request and inspect an uncertain result using read-only catalog/history queries; no automatic repeat.
transactionAndLimits.notification: pg_notify('pgrst','reload schema') is delivered on surrounding transaction commit. Reload success and Data API reachability remain separate checks.
transactionAndLimits.cost: No paid AI/render operations or finished-ad debits. No new infrastructure resources are provisioned by this SQL.

ordering: Review independent native PostgreSQL verification and independent proposal review.
Obtain exact production mutation approval for target and proposal hash.
Refresh read-only target catalog: required rate_limit.sql/credits.sql schema exists and consume_finished_ad remains absent; confirm postgres migration identity.
Apply the exact approved proposal via apply_migration on varoqxjccqmskzeejagn only.
Confirm migration history and exact catalog postconditions without calling the debit RPC against real users.
Confirm PostgREST schema/transport behavior separately without spending a real user's allowance.
Only then deploy updated callers under separate deployment authorization. Main merge and deployment are separate decisions.

rollback.beforeCommit: Any error in the DO statement automatically rolls back its function and ACL changes. A timed-out or lost response still requires fresh read-only inspection before retry.
rollback.afterCommit: Leave the additive function and all receipts/balances intact pending a reviewed forward fix. If necessary, stop affected paid entry points through a separately authorized operational action. Do not automatically drop the function or roll back to the original duplicate-charge protocol.
rollback.reapply: Intentionally fails if the function already exists, even if it matches. Confirm catalog/history and decide explicitly; do not convert it back to CREATE OR REPLACE.
rollback.legacyCallers: Existing separate-RPC callers remain exposed to their original race until updated callers are deployed. This additive migration does not repair historical charges or change existing receipts.

confirmedByBuilder: Source raw SHA256 matches the approved source.
Embedded function prosrc MD5 matches 7cfd6fb078444301ec89dfebf51dbf54; only CREATE OR REPLACE was changed to CREATE.
Proposal bytes were re-opened and hash computed after writing.
verification.independentNativeRuntime: Pending wrapper-specific run; core RPC native PostgreSQL verifier passed separately in attempt-03-native-result.json.
verification.targetExecution: NOT RUN; no target mutation authorization.
verification.postgrestReachability: NOT RUN; catalog and native SQL results do not establish Data API cache/transport behavior.

references.supports: DO executes a transient anonymous block; no transaction control is embedded in this proposal.
Notifications generated inside a transaction are delivered only after commit.
NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema' requests a schema-cache reload; reload failure is possible.
Migration failure atomicity must be considered; do not rely on unverified runner transaction behavior.
